doc.brief: Presents a horizontal bar of items that pop up menus when clicked.
doc.md:
Presents a horizontal bar of items that pop up menus when clicked.

The only way to create instances of `GtkPopoverMenuBar` is
from a `GMenuModel`.

# CSS nodes

```
menubar
├── item[.active]
┊   ╰── popover
╰── item
    ╰── popover
```

`GtkPopoverMenuBar` has a single CSS node with name menubar, below which
each item has its CSS node, and below that the corresponding popover.

The item whose popover is currently open gets the .active
style class.

# Accessibility

`GtkPopoverMenuBar` uses the [`AccessibleRole.menu_bar`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:menu_bar) role,
the menu items use the [`AccessibleRole.menu_item`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:menu_item) role and
the menus use the [`AccessibleRole.menu`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:menu) role.

add_child.brief: Adds a custom widget to a generated menubar.
add_child.md:
Adds a custom widget to a generated menubar.

For this to work, the menu model of `bar` must have an
item with a `custom` attribute that matches `id`.

get_menu_model.md: Returns the model from which the contents of `bar` are taken.

remove_child.md:
Removes a widget that has previously been added with
gtk_popover_menu_bar_add_child().

set_menu_model.brief: Sets a menu model from which `bar` should take its contents.
set_menu_model.md:
Sets a menu model from which `bar` should take
its contents.

menu-model.brief: The `GMenuModel` from which the menu bar is created.
menu-model.md:
The `GMenuModel` from which the menu bar is created.

The model should only contain submenus as toplevel elements.
